tete.definition: n. A kind of wig; false hair.

tete-a-tete.definition:
n. a private conversation between two people
s. involving two persons; intimately private
tete-a-tete.translation:
adv. 面对面地, 两人私下地
a. 面对面的, 两人私下的
n. 两人之间的私下谈话/会见, 促膝谈心, 面对面式的双人沙发

teterrimous.translation:
teterrimous (comparative more teterrimous, superlative most teterrimous)
(rare) Extremely foul or ugly; horrible; terrible.
